as_told.title: Anonymous Navy scientist on extended electrodynamics in Townsend Brown episode

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he learned about a theory called extended electrodynamics, a wider version of the standard physics of electricity and magnetism laid down by James Clerk Maxwell and Oliver Heaviside, from a senior Navy scientist who asked to stay anonymous for fear of trouble from his bosses. Michels says the interview appeared in his documentary about Townsend Brown, an inventor he calls a man who built UFOs for the CIA, and he returns to it in later episodes. He raises it because, if the theory holds, it might explain how unusual craft could move.
